description: This file defines the BitConfigField class, which is a custom UI component for configuring individual bits within a configuration environment. It extends BaseConfigField and interacts with messages, configuration images, and user actions to display and modify a specific bit in a byte buffer.

classes.name: BitConfigField
classes.description: A UI component for editing a single bit within a configuration, listening to messages and updating its display accordingly.

methods.name: BitConfigField
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components, message listener, and action handling for the bit configuration.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the checkbox state to represent the bit value and manages the editing state flag.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads the current value of the bit from a ConfigurationImage instance into the UI.
